record_title: Sharp power-correlation range for stationary renewal age and residual life
provenance: An exact distribution-free identification region for the Pearson correlation of equal positive powers of stationary backward and forward recurrence times, derived from the Schur-constant radial-uniform representation and sharp moment-ratio bounds.
limitations: Stationary setting; equal positive powers and Pearson correlation only; the upper endpoint is a supremum; older Schur-constant and l1-symmetric literature remains a residual terminology-equivalence risk.
